errors.evidence: The vertical axis range is 0 to 40, not 0 to 30 as shown in the image.

The color mapping is incorrect. Based on the image and atom checklist: mBERT-L₂ is light blue, XLM-L₂ is dark blue, mBERT-R₂ is light green, XLM-R₂ is dark green, mBERT-B₂ is pink, and XLM-B₂ is red. The description incorrectly assigns colors to models.
The tallest bars in the IE-Germanic category reach approximately 15-18, not 24-26 as stated. The image shows values closer to 15-18.
The description does not mention the approximate values for the IE-Indic group (17 to 23) or the Uralic group (mostly below 5), which are important for understanding the data distribution.
The description does not mention the approximate range of values for the Semitic group (-8 to about 20), which is an important detail.
The description does not explicitly state that the error bars indicate variability within model effects, nor does it mention that the Semitic group has larger error bars.
